title: Trapping Rain Water
statement: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

driverCode.python:
##SOLUTION##

import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
i = 0
n = int(data[i]); i += 1
height = [int(x) for x in data[i:i+n]]; i += n
ans = trap(height)
print(ans)

title: Word Break II Feasibility
statement: Given a string s and a dictionary of strings wordDict, return true if s can be segmented into dictionary words where additionally every prefix of length >= 2 of s must also independently be segmentable (a stricter variant used to test deeper DP reasoning).

driverCode.python:
##SOLUTION##

import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
i = 0
s = data[i]; i += 1
m = int(data[i]); i += 1
wordDict = data[i:i+m]; i += m
ans = wordBreak(s, wordDict)
print("true" if ans else "false")

title: Sliding Window Maximum
